review_time_definition: Wall-clock from first detailed inspection to submission; includes coordination/tool delays, not independent human labor.

anchors.quote: No source region is justified for either supported migration family. kernel.py lines 9-26 implement deterministic dense Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting and back substitution over binary64 values, not finite-domain predicate search or binary combinatorial optimization. The region depends on the validated matrix and right-hand side, uses a mutable augmented-row array as internal state, and is activated only by program.py lines 22-27 when mode is solve. Preserved behavior includes selecting the largest absolute pivot with the first index winning ties, rejecting an exact zero pivot, retaining Python floating-point evaluation order, detecting nonfinite solutions, and returning the named solution, deltas, and proposed residual. kernel.py lines 29-38 compute Ax-b and the specified scaled backward error deterministically from the matrix, right-hand side, and selected vector; this behavior is required for the current vector in both modes and for the proposed vector in solve mode. Validation, inspect-mode handling, empty-system results, exception behavior, report ordering, and nonmutation must also remain intact. No finite candidate domain, pure Boolean predicate, binary objective, constraint encoding, exact solution encoding, or acceptable probabilistic replacement is supplied. The HPL attribution supports only the provenance of the classical algorithm and diagnostic; the software is explicitly not a compliant HPL performance run, and no quantum workload, hardware, resource, benchmark, or advantage evidence is provided.

The program provides neither a finite candidate set nor a pure Boolean marked-state predicate. Creating one would require an arbitrary encoding of solution vectors and a reversible oracle preserving binary64 elimination, first-index pivot ties, exact-zero singularity rejection, overflow handling, and deterministic success or failure semantics.

binding.rationale: The revision retains an empty candidate list and null plan. Descriptions of the original classical solver are not a proposed replacement. The structural-negative assertion is not independently established by this checker.
